dimensions.assessment: Maintains existing operational protection authorities against unmanned aircraft without altering their scope.

dimensions.evidence: Section 210G(i) of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (6 U.S.C. 124n(i)) is amended by striking 'September 30, 2025' and inserting 'September 30, 2028'

dimensions.assessment: Extends authorities for a fixed three-year period until September 30, 2028.
